question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Abscond
solution:
The correct answer is: **Endure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abscond"** means to leave hurriedly and secretly, typically to avoid detection or arrest. (गुप्त रूप से भाग जाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The thief **absconded** with the money before the police arrived.
 
 
 
• **"Endure"** refers to the ability to tolerate or withstand something, particularly difficult situations, without running away or escaping. (सहना)
 
 
• **Example:** She **endured** the harsh weather conditions during her trek to the mountains.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Abscond'** is **'Endure'**, as enduring implies facing a situation rather than escaping or fleeing from it.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Endure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Withdraw** (पीछे हटना): To retreat or move away from a situation.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to **withdraw** from the competition due to injury.
 
 
 
• **Flee** (भाग जाना): To run away from a place or situation of danger.
 
 
• **Example:** The residents **fled **the town during the flood.
 
 
 
• **Hide** (छिपाना): To conceal oneself or something from view or detection.
 
 
• **Example:** She **hid **the gift in the closet to surprise her friend.
